verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that Earth Class Mail offers APIs that keep documents and mail in sync with other tools and stores digital scans in the cloud. That suggests mail data can be pulled out programmatically, but nothing describes a bulk export or the file formats involved. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, explicit open or standard export formats, export of metadata such as AI labels and summaries, account-closure or migration guidance, and independent confirmation that export works.
